name: standard settings of the method
description: Loss weights of the spot model used for every reported run. pipeline/standard_runner.py installs them and pipeline/core.py checks that the code defaults agree; --override of pipeline/run_condition.py changes single weights (hyperparameter comparison, lambda_mix_gene = 1.0 on the public data).

random_seeds.data: data seed of the simulation (21-30 for the final evaluation, 11-13 for the hyperparameter comparison)
random_seeds.clustering_and_mapping: --seed of pipeline/run_condition.py: PCA and Leiden clustering of the reference and the SIMO mapping
random_seeds.training: 1 for every run: initial weights and mini-batch order of the autoencoder, the spot model and CellOT
